description: Add a 'prediction-data status' Typer command group as the entry point for all monitoring and audit subcommands
steps: Create src/prediction_data/cli/status.py with a Typer app for the status command group
Register the status app as a subcommand in cli/main.py
Verify 'prediction-data status --help' lists all subcommands
Add shared options/utilities for --platform and --entity filtering (reuse across subcommands)
Add shared table formatting utility for consistent terminal output (platform | entity | dt | rows | etc.)

description: Add 'prediction-data status coverage' command to show which dates have data, which are missing, and row counts per platform/entity/date
steps: Implement 'prediction-data status coverage --start-date YYYY-MM-DD --end-date YYYY-MM-DD [--platform] [--entity]'
List S3 prefixes under bronze/{platform}/{entity}/dt={date}/ for each date in the range
For each date with data, read the manifest(s) to extract run count and total row_count
Identify missing dates (dates in the range with no S3 prefix) and flag them as gaps
Display results as a table: date | platform | entity | runs | total_rows | latest_run_time
Add a summary line: total dates, dates with data, missing dates, total rows
Support --platform and --entity filters (default: all platforms and entities)
Add unit tests with mocked S3Client covering full coverage, partial gaps, and empty ranges

description: Add 'prediction-data status runs' command to list recent ingestion runs with metadata from manifests
steps: Implement 'prediction-data status runs [--platform] [--entity] [--dt YYYY-MM-DD] [--last N]'
List S3 manifest keys matching the filters, download and parse each manifest
Display results as a table: run_id | platform | entity | dt | row_count | generated_at
Sort by generated_at descending (most recent first)
Default --last to 20 runs; allow override
When --dt is specified, show all runs for that date (not limited by --last)
Add unit tests with mocked S3Client for filtering, sorting, and limit behavior

description: Add 'prediction-data status show-run' command to display full details of a specific ingestion run
steps: Implement 'prediction-data status show-run <run_id>' that finds and displays a single run's manifest
Search S3 for manifest keys containing the run_id (support partial prefix matching)
Display full manifest fields: run_id, platform, entity, dt, generated_at, row_count
List all part files referenced in the manifest with their S3 keys
Display source metadata: api_base_url, pagination method, final cursor value
Exit with error and helpful message if run_id not found
Add unit tests for found/not-found cases and partial prefix matching

description: Add 'prediction-data status validate' command to check manifest integrity and detect orphaned or incomplete data
steps: Implement 'prediction-data status validate --start-date YYYY-MM-DD --end-date YYYY-MM-DD [--platform] [--entity]'
For each date/platform/entity combo, list all S3 keys under the prefix
Check that every run directory contains a valid _manifest.json (parseable, required fields present)
Verify that every part file listed in the manifest actually exists in S3
Detect orphaned data files (part-NNN.jsonl.gz files in directories without a manifest)
Flag manifests with row_count=0 as empty runs
Report results: valid runs, invalid manifests, missing part files, orphaned files, empty runs
Exit with non-zero code if any validation errors found
Add unit tests covering valid data, missing manifests, missing parts, orphaned files, and empty runs

description: Add comprehensive tests for all status commands and update project documentation
steps: Create tests/test_status.py with unit tests for all status subcommands using mocked S3Client
Ensure all tests pass: pytest -m 'not integration'
Ensure type checking passes: mypy src/
Ensure linting passes: ruff check src/ tests/
Update CLAUDE.md with new status CLI command examples
Update RELEASE.md CLI Contract (section 9) with the new status commands
